newsitem.title: USA: INCSTAR Corp Q1 net falls as merger nears.
newsitem.headline: INCSTAR Corp Q1 net falls as merger nears.

text.p: INCSTAR Corp, which signed a definitive merger agreement with American Standard Cos Inc last month, said Tuesday its earnings in the first quarter ended April 4 tumbled due to lower sales and gross margins.

The company reported net income of $721,000, or $0.04 a share, compared with $1.2 million, or $0.07, in the same period last year. Sales fell to $10.8 million from $11.5 million last year, INCSTAR said.
INCSTAR said 1996 results included sales from a one-time test stemming from a competitor's product that was unavailable between June of 1995 until March of 1996.
The American Standard merger still requires shareholder and other approvals, INCSTAR said.
